notes.title: Version 1.32B released
notes.notes:
Bug fixed: Switches in the Sealed Cave were not working.

Description errors were fixed: Weapon techniques were incorrectly described.

notes.title: Version 1.32A released.
notes.notes:
Fixed a setting error that prevented Belial from joining the party during a sub-event.
Added a support character during the white rat sub-event.

notes.title: Version 1.32 released
notes.notes:
Fixed missing English translations in some shops.
Fixed an issue where the left hand symbol was displayed as the right hand when dual-wielding.
Added new items to Gabriel's Room and the Stellar Apartments.
Added icons to the descriptions of status recovery items.

notes.title: 1.31 Update
notes.notes: Added English language to major parts.

notes.title: 1.30 Update
notes.notes:
Venus added to the main event of Episode 2.
One sub-event added.

Factor cheat added.
Factor EXP up added.
Mercury items and enemies added.
Angel C can now be recruited at the Primeval Ten pub.

・Factor: How to obtain and use cheats.
Enter the warehouse next to Mikael's room.
The items are in the grey barrels.
Select a factor from the menu and equip your character!

notes.title: 1.21 Bug fixes
notes.notes:
- Fixed a fatal bug that caused Sephira to be unusable after using Beauty Salon.
- Fixed a settings error where the building to the right of Moonlight Heaven was connected to the weapon shop in Primeval Heaven.
- Other battle balance adjustments.
